caption:
The water board asked by mail. Now ERCOT asks before the power flows.

Records the Texas Tribune obtained for 2020 through 2025 count 334 data center facilities. 233 never submitted a requested water use survey. The Tribune reports a fine of up to $500 for skipping it. The board says it has no authority of its own to prosecute.

Does ERCOT's request reach those 233? No. The survey goes only to data centers already operating. The request reaches proposed data centers from 25 MW and Batch Zero loads not yet energized.

ERCOT's September 14th notice puts the water board's questions in Section C. The developer's own utility files each response. A complete one carries a notarized attestation. A failure to respond is reported to the PUC and the Office of the Governor.

Will the report ERCOT expects to publish by December 10th say how many responded?

#ERCOT #TWDB #BatchZero
